messages:
aitor: Quick sync on PR #5340 — the embeddings page has several inconsistencies that are tripping up users: the raw API examples use `inputs` while runtime expects `documents` for batch requests; curl examples sometimes omit Content-Type or use text/plain; and the OpenAPI example response shows scores in a different order than runtime returns.
zoe: Good catch. We intentionally moved from `inputs` -> `documents` last quarter to make naming align with other batch endpoints. Docs should be updated to show `documents` in raw JSON examples and a migration note for folks still using `inputs`.
kevin: About ordering: the runtime returns embeddings in the same order as the provided documents. The OpenAPI example mistakenly showed a shuffled order from an earlier test fixture. That causes confusion when people map scores back to inputs.
sam: Action items: 1) normalize request examples to `documents` (snake_case for raw API), 2) ensure Content-Type: application/json in curl/js/python raw examples, 3) update OpenAPI example response to preserve input order and include a short note about deterministic ordering.
aitor: Example of bad curl from PR (copied):

```bash
# bad (from PR)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '["first doc","second doc"]'
```

Problems: header case, missing Content-Type, and using array body without the `documents` wrapper.

zoe: Proposed canonical curl for docs:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-redwood-1","documents":["first doc","second doc"]}'
```

kevin: OpenAPI response to use in examples (ensure order preserved):

```json
{
  "model": "embed-redwood-1",
  "embeddings": [
    { "index": 0, "vector": [0.01, -0.03, ...] },
    { "index": 1, "vector": [0.02, 0.11, ...] }
  ]
}
```

kevin: Note: include `index` so clients can map even if they transform/pipe docs later.
sam: Also update SDK snippet docs: JS/py SDKs already accept `documents` and map camelCase in the SDK. Add a short migration note: "If you were using `inputs`, rename to `documents` for raw API calls; SDKs are unaffected."
aitor: I'll patch the OpenAPI file and replace the example fixtures. Zoe, can you update the docs page snippets (curl/js/py)? I'll also add a tiny doc-lint rule to catch missing Content-Type in curl examples.
zoe: Yup taking the snippets. I'll standardize header casing and add a one-line example showing batch vs single-call shapes.
doc-bot: CI: preview build for branch fix-5340 -> https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/preview/5340 (lint OK, staging link available)
kevin: After merges I'll backfill a short changelog entry: "Embeddings: raw API examples now use `documents` and examples standardize Content-Type + response order." Thanks all.
aitor: Great — closing after PR merge.
